name: Brood vent icon
description: UI slot icon for the broodling. Composes `ss.proj.drone` via `use`, so the thing in the slot is the thing orbiting you — when that document stopped being a cold shell plate and became a red-brown vent, this followed with no edit here. Rim keeps the original i_drone's aqua.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_drone_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
